title: Source-grounded construction and structural selection
note: Architecture of the implemented selector. Proposal uses the full pool and up to two existing Document blocks. Accepted witnesses are checked for complete support and pairwise relations. The expanded module retains conservative family unions, enumerates up to 64 family-union seeds, applies budget and active balance constraints, fills by the common priority and ranks the constructed feasible packets. Only original selected source text reaches the reader.

title: Source-level construction of the confirmation conditions
note: Illustrative film, person and date. Eligibility uses connected official evidence triples and supporting facts in distinct documents. Original candidate documents remain in each pool. The conflict condition appends a terminal sentence with year shifted by seven; ordinary controls append an unchanged copy. Source titles and presentation status are matched. Conditions contain distinct assigned questions, not paired copies of every question.
